newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Res awards project to parent unit.
newsitem.headline: China Res awards project to parent unit.

text.p: China Resources Enterprise Ltd said on Wednesday its 55-percent owned Harvest Fair Investment Ltd has by letter of intent awarded two contruction contracts to T.S. Wong & Co Ltd, a company controlled by its parent.
The main contract works amounted to HK$758.2 million, China Resources Enterprise said.
China Resources (Holdings) Co Ltd, which owns 99.6 percent of T.S. Wong & Co, holds 53.1 percent of China Resources Enterprise.

China Resources Enterprise said the contracts were related to a residential development project comprising 10 residential towers in Tsing Yi. The whole project was expected to be completed by the end of 1999.
